guidance: Operator approvals are session scoped. Spending, destruction, public communication, credentials and newly trusted MCP servers require approval bound to the exact action.
Question requests are durable and scoped to one session; repeat the same pending request to retrieve its identity. An answered question cannot be changed.
Authored role prompts retain exact text and revision concurrency. Reset only the selected role; compiled prompts and their hashes use the same authored composition.
Attach selected files by exact decoded content identity. Context imports require explicit reviewed selection, redact credentials and carry durable source hashes into delegated bounded packets.
The a-control startup procedure executes request-answer-reopen, save-reset-compose, attachment retry/refusal and staged import-tamper workflows only in a supplied scratch root.
Model context startup opens a real SQLite ledger, emits provider cache keys and writes exact metrics receipts; progressive discovery defers schemas until describe.
Image startup creates a workspace PNG, invokes the real SDK image tool, converts the image through Chat Completions and checks outside-path refusal without a provider call.

Submission startup creates a disposable Git baseline and verifies accepted source hashes plus refused drift, missing files, forbidden phases, stale nested evidence, contradictory counts, omitted Git deltas and redacted secrets.

Stream startup starts a finite child process and observes text emitted during a real silence interval, newest tail reads, and durable results at the real 4 MiB boundary. No provider performance is claimed.

Connected-device startup reopens durable scoped permissions and proves denial/audit/planning receipts. Host labels refer to disposable local metadata fixtures; no NAS sync, GitHub command, credential or physical device is used or claimed.

Local action startup creates disposable Git/workspace scopes, confines cleanup to their isolation container, performs handsfree writes and lease-authorized commands, and observes a real124 timeout. Provider/supervisor delegation remains unproven.

Connected Chrome startup drives only a fresh empty owned profile at CDP48466 and a controlled local HTML document. Missing approval leaves DOM unchanged; exact granted approval clicks and verifies changed DOM. No provider login or everyday browser tab is used.

Plan startup reads full and tailed disposable provider transcripts, preserving task IDs, failed/sidechain exclusion, late results, stable history cache and paging independence; reported rate windows survive a fresh service process. No provider model or CLI is invoked.

Browser dependency startup uses a finite diagnostic executable to prove missing-library parsing, package plans, dry-run persistence and runtime cache environment, without installation or Linux browser performance claims.

Standalone CU accepts explicit discovery_urls so restricted callers probe only their assigned ports. Startup records actual unavailable-server failures at vacant48465, canonical aliases and CLI list; it does not claim product UI acceptance.

An actual missing-server failure emits standalone recovery commands and the conventional UI start hint in its durable receipt; explicitly supplied discovery_urls alone are probed. The docs assertion is replaced by this emitted operator response, with no contact to the hinted default port.

Capability initialization uses an explicit empty vault configuration under disposable proof state. Saved broker/account configurations are never read; these procedures make no vault/account execution claim.

contracts.claim: Approval decisions reflect classified category, current session mode, first-server trust and exact action grants.
Settings describes every protected category and all modes; approve-all is session scoped.
Successful question transactions persist the exact returned row without changing unrelated entries.
At most one pending question exists per session; observers retain exact session and pending filters.
Answered questions retain question identity, immutable answers and retry idempotence.
Every loaded library preserves authored/default role text and exact composed hashes for five roles.
Successful save/reset commits exactly the next payload and revision; invalid or stale saves are rejected.
Token accounting equals accumulated events and thresholds determine current status.
Compaction retains every exact user message and a marker for non-user activity.
Image extension derives from bytes, independent of filename.
Attachment names are sanitized and content-addressed; returned paths stay inside the selected folder and contain exact decoded bytes.
Message retains authored text and every attached path, with a default instruction only for empty text.
Staged upload uses a generated identity, sanitized display name, exact byte count and hash-bound durable receipt.
Preview requires selection, redacts credential text and imports only user/assistant response messages from Codex rollouts.
Import persists only explicitly selected reviewed rows with exact content, source hashes and lineage.
Every read refuses duplicate, extra, foreign, incomplete or hash-conflicting rows against the durable receipt.
Delegated selected context packets retain source/import lineage and exact selected content within item and character bounds.
Durable bundle retains schema, messages and stable/full cache identities.
Provider cache hints preserve stable identity and report unsupported provider status honestly.
Assembled prompts and provider payloads preserve nested and flattened cache identities.
Durable context receipt preserves all recorded invocation, token, tool and image counters.
Progressive tools list/search omit schemas by default and describe returns the selected real schema.
Chat Completion image transport moves the exact two latest image observations to supported user content without changing tool input.
Workspace image tool refuses outside images and returns exact image file pixels; provider-compatible reasoning stays on the appropriate wire.
Incoming source-bound submission verdict exactly reflects all validation errors.
Incoming receipts validate allowed/forbidden phase scope, before Git hashes, current after hashes, missing and deleted files.
Incoming proof hashes and nested source lineage must describe current changed files; live/device claims require corresponding evidence kinds.
Incoming summaries and command exit/count results must be internally consistent.
Receipt changedFiles equals the exact in-scope Git baseline delta, including deletions and untracked files.
Secret-like incoming receipt keys/values are refused with a fixed redacted error before other inspection.
Every emitted text is the exact ordered accepted prefix, merged only within matching kind and item metadata, preserving first arrival.
Persisted text chunks reconstruct accepted message within 4000 characters and preserve supplied rounded timestamps.
Backward block scan returns newest matching event even across line boundaries.
Actual runtime child callbacks release coalesced text on deadline during silence; raw stdout remains complete.
Durable results omit session window copies, retain references and preserve usage when oversized metadata is dropped.
Removing duplicate session windows preserves every unrelated turn field and durable conversation reference.
Every bridge decision preserves requested lane and identity; approved file roots, command prefixes and inspection surfaces carry current scoped authority.
Operation receipts preserve each host/audit/sync identity and aggregate denied before pending; plan-only receipts claim no execution.
Persisted operator capability/scope grants read back exactly and are merged into current host permissions.
Snapshots expose the actual host capabilities, mapping and pending/denied permissions without claiming command execution.
Received structured feedback retains exact event/handoff identity, routing, task, verifier and followup context.
Prepared execution scopes accurately distinguish direct workspace, real Git worktree or filesystem copy and local storage/host.
Verification steps retain the real verification surface; proposals preserve branch and isolation target identity.
Execution preserves required approval/lease attribution and turns actual deadlines into failed124 receipts.
Isolation cleanup is confined to the source workspace sibling container and accurately reports remaining directories.
Explicit role routing determines delegated phase without objective verification words contaminating execute steps.
Routine navigation remains routine; destructive, capacity and unknown controls ask using exact page/action fingerprints.
Consequential actions refuse absent or cross-action fingerprint approval.
Authentication confidence follows readable page evidence; instance rows retain visible heuristic provenance and GPU/status.
Project memory reopens accepted purpose/checkpoint fields and never persists rejected unknown input.
Approved browser actions verify expected changed DOM after readback; missing approval performs no action.

Explicit Neyvia native browser proposals require a fresh observed revision, owner tab grant and recomputed approval; completion and expected page effects come only from actual native action and fresh DOM readback.
Actual bounded version subprocess diagnosis determines availability and missing-library repair packages.
Dry repair produces durable planned commands and unchanged diagnostic before/after, never executes installation.
Every checklist operation preserves exact task IDs/order/text/status, clears empty replacements and keeps changing sequence/time.
Only app-reported plan windows persist atomically under service root, with bounded percentages and reported resets/timestamps.
Dashboard counts actual subagent calls and preserves owner-start precedence while displaying reply activity without private reasoning.
History folds match current tail stamp, exclude materialized/paged duplicate task calls and include matching late results before final transitions.
Agents manual remains in current discoverable index and loads through a real rooted workspace service after grounded schema validation.
Compact v2 CU receipts preserve accepted result identity, exclude giant trees and maintain exact latest mirror.
Standalone acceptance keeps unavailable/skipped/failed evidence failed with exact summary counts.
Compatibility aliases resolve registered canonical flows and standalone CLI lists current canonical names.

Actual unavailable-server responses emit standalone frontend-start and CU verification recovery commands, default control URL and the explicitly probed candidate context, never a test-suite recovery command.
